text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the curtains close on the spring<n>Tenno Sho!
What a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Super Creek has never run so<n>magnificently!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What the—?! Where did all that<n>strength come
from?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I mean, I was the one who won, but<n>still...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You ran way more intensely than I<n>did... Such
strength!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is it really you? Are you really the<n>Super Creek I
know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, you're not my Super Creek... But<n>I've seen that
look on your face<n>before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So that's how you managed a race<n>like that...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whew, that was an impressive race,<n>Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You really are my lifelong rival.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But there are two Tenno Sho<n>races—spring and
autumn. Kyoto and<n>Tokyo. West and east. Cherry
blossoms and autumn leaves.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I, Oguri Cap, shall be your opponent at<n>the autumn
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Er, did I mess up? Was that the<n>wrong vibe?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that was good. But don't get all<n>serious on me
outta the blue like that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so Super Creek managed to get<n>a great result
in her spring race<n>against Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But why does she seem to have<n>gotten over all
that's happened?
